Changelog:
The ping chart now always shows the timeout count next to the server address, written out as "TimeOut" instead of "TO". It turns red once there is at least one, with the T and O highlighted to show what the server bar's "TO" stands for. The server address is gold to match the average line.

Both the ping and FPS charts now keep the main numbers on the left and push the extra info (timeouts, min and max) to the right edge of the window.
